# Chart.js Extra Examples

This page demonstrates various chart types and options available in the Chart.js extra for MarkdownMaster CMS.

## Bar Chart

:::bar
# Monthly Signups
| Month | Signups |
|:-----:|--------:|
| Jan   | 10      |
| Feb   | 45      |
| Mar   | 22      |
:::

## Line Chart

:::line
# Sales Trend
| Month | Revenue | Expenses |
|-------|---------|----------|
| Jan   | 100     | 60       |
| Feb   | 150     | 80       |
| Mar   | 200     | 90       |
:::

## Pie Chart

:::pie
# Market Share
| Product | Share |
|---------|-------|
| A       | 40    |
| B       | 30    |
| C       | 20    |
| D       | 10    |
:::

## Donut Chart

:::donut
# Budget Allocation
| Category | Amount |
|----------|--------|
| Marketing| 500    |
| R&D      | 300    |
| Operations| 200   |
:::

## Stacked Bar Chart

:::bar .stacked
# Team Performance
| Task | Alice | Bob | Carol |
|------|-------|-----|-------|
| Task 1 | 50    | 70  | 60    |
| Task 2 | 80    | 90  | 40    |
:::

## Line Chart with Fill

:::line .fill
# Temperature
| Day | Celsius |
|-----|---------|
| Mon | 20      |
| Tue | 22      |
| Wed | 18      |
| Thu | 25      |
:::

## Chart Without Legend

:::pie .no-legend
# Preferences
| Color | Count |
|-------|-------|
| Red   | 30    |
| Blue  | 40    |
| Green | 30    |
:::

## Mixed Dataset Line Chart

:::line
# Multi-Series Data
| Year | Sales | Profit | Expenses |
|------|-------|--------|----------|
| 2018 | 100   | 20     | 80       |
| 2019 | 150   | 30     | 120      |
| 2020 | 200   | 40     | 160      |
| 2021 | 250   | 50     | 200      |
:::

## Chart with Non-Numeric Data

:::bar
# Test Results
| Test | Score |
|------|-------|
| Test A | 85    |
| Test B | 92    |
| Test C | Invalid |
| Test D | 78    |
:::
